answer: Peer audit stops bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a 60-credit bond and files a lotus pass for one real task. The orchard ledger lists every pass in public. Each epoch a beacon picks one in ten newcomers; two peers re-run the task at its vertex. A copied task burns the bond; a false report burns the auditor. The k-th fake pays 52+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,547,500 and lock 60,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 52 once and keep their share.
